en/solve/solv-buy-computer.title: How to buy a computer?
en/solve/solv-buy-computer.summary: The best computer that fits our capacity and needs.
en/solve/solv-buy-computer.content:
Hi, I’m Nicolás, and just like you, I’ve been learning how to improve my internet connection. I’m no expert, but by digging around online, watching tutorials, and learning through trial and error, I’ve managed to boost internet quality in areas with poor connectivity.
What does buying a computer look like for you?
In this guide, I’ll help you clear up some important points to help you make the right call. We’ll break down the main features of a computer and look at some recommendations based on those specs. You’ll also be able to weigh your own needs and budget. I hope you feel supported and confident as you go through the process of picking out a machine.
What is this for?
Making a purchase in a field where we aren’t experts can be a real headache. That’s why we put this solution together—to walk you through the process. At the end of the day, this guide is here to help you make an informed decision so you don’t waste your hard-earned money or end up with a computer that doesn’t actually do what you need it to.
How do I know if I need one?
Deciding whether or not to make a purchase comes down to two fundamental questions:

Think it over carefully: What need is this computer actually solving? Can this need be met in another way? For example, can you do the same thing with the phone you already have, or maybe a tablet?
If you’ve confirmed that the need can only be met with a computer, it’s time to look at other options before buying. For instance, can you borrow a computer from school or the library? Can you get a donated machine from a family member or a local business?

If you’ve exhausted those options and have definitely decided to buy a computer, then this guide is for you.
What are the advantages of a computer over a phone?
Speed and capacity are two of the biggest perks computers have over phones. With a computer, you’ve got a keyboard and a mouse at your disposal, which lets you type and navigate menus way faster. Plus, a computer’s larger screen lets you organize your digital workspace in a way a tiny phone screen just can’t. It also allows you to…
These factors don’t just save you time; they also let you multitask. On a computer, you can switch between apps more easily and even have them open side-by-side on the screen. For example, you can have a window open with your resume and another with a job you’re applying for. Or, if you’re hunting for the best deal, you can have pages for several products open at once to compare them easily.

What are the options?

Desktop Computer

This is a computer designed to stay in one spot, like a desk or table. The hardware components are usually housed in a “tower” or case that holds the motherboard and all the other parts.


Laptop

Often just called a “laptop,” this is a computer you can move or carry around with relative ease. Laptops are small, light, and specifically designed so their batteries can keep them running for a good chunk of time (usually 4 to 5 hours). Screen sizes typically range from 11 to 15 inches.


Pros and Cons









































CategoryDesktopLaptopPortabilityStays in a fixed location.Can be carried around easily.CostMore affordable.More expensive.Upgrades & CustomizationHardware components are easy to upgrade and improve. This makes it easy to tailor to your needs.It’s getting harder to upgrade hardware since most parts are integrated. Some allow for RAM or hard drive swaps.Power IndependenceMust always be plugged into a power outlet.Has a battery, so it can run unplugged for a few hours. However, batteries wear out over time and eventually need replacing.Energy ConsumptionUses more power.Uses less power since components are more compact.SpaceTakes up more space.Takes up very little space.

What should I keep in mind to make this decision?

Step 0 → Before we start: ALERT! What are hardware and software?

It’s important to know there are two basic parts to a computer: Hardware → and software:

Hardware →: The physical parts that make up the computer.
Software: The programs, instructions, data, and rules that tell the computer how to perform specific tasks.

Below, we’ll explain the main hardware components that matter when you’re buying.













































ElementImageDescriptionProcessor (CPU) →This is the brain of the machine—definitely one of the most important factors. Remember, the more powerful this is, the faster your computer will run your commands.StorageThe hard drive → determines how much stuff you can save on your machine.RAM MemoryThe RAM memory → temporarily stores data for the apps you’re currently using. The more RAM you have, the better your computer handles running multiple programs at once.Graphics CardThe graphics card handles processing data related to the images and videos you see on your screen.PeripheralsThese are the input and output ports for other devices you’ll plug into your computer. For example: USB ports →, audio jacks, HDMI, etc.ScreenThis is what lets you see what you’re doing.BatteryOnly applies to laptops; it determines how long you can use it without being plugged into the wall.


Step 1 → The fundamental criteria

Now that you know the main hardware parts, let’s talk about what differentiates performance and cost, and the questions you should ask yourself to choose the right option.








































ElementDetailRelevant QuestionsProcessorIf you want a fast computer that handles tasks effectively without lagging, look at the number of cores. Also, check the frequency or clock speed. Higher numbers mean better performance, measured in GHz (gigahertz). So, 3GHz is much better than 2.5GHz. As for brands: If you can afford it, go with Intel; if you need something cheaper, go with AMD. And if you’re really tight on cash, choose Celeron.How many programs do you use at once? What will you use the computer for—designing, browsing, gaming?Intel or AMD?How many cores?Storage500 GB is plenty for “normal” home use. If you save lots of movies or series, you might need 1 TB (terabyte) or more. Speed is also key. It’s measured in RPM (revolutions per minute)—higher is better for reading/writing data. There are two main technologies: Traditional Hard Drive (HDD), which is slower but cheaper, and Solid State Drive (SSD), which is faster but pricier.SSD or HDD? How much info will you save? Do you want the computer to turn on fast?RAM MemoryThe more RAM, the better your computer handles multiple programs at once. How much you need depends 100% on how you use it. If you use design or editing software, you’ll need more. If you’re into design or gaming, or just have the budget for a super fast machine, get 16GB. For standard tasks (writing, browsing), 8GB is enough. If you’re on a tight budget, you can settle for 4GB, but be prepared for it to be a bit slow.What programs will I use? How many GB do I need?Graphics CardThis might be a big deal or not, depending on your use. For basic tasks, any card works. But if you need to do graphic design or gaming, a dedicated graphics card is ideal. Don’t overcomplicate it. For standard use, you don’t need a fancy card. Any Radeon or Nvidia card will serve you well.Will I use it for gaming or design? Nvidia or Radeon?ScreenYou’ll be staring at this a lot, so it needs to be comfortable and easy on your eyes. Consider:Size: If you need to carry it around, 14 inches is ideal. If you’re doing graphic work, you need a bigger screen.Resolution: A big screen with bad resolution is useless. 1080p is Full HD and is quite good. Monitors up to 23” are recommended to avoid the pixelated look you get with low-res images.How many inches do I need? What resolution is enough for my needs?Do you need to run multiple programs while designing or watching movies?AudioThis depends on the speakers you buy for a desktop. Laptops aren’t known for great audio, though “gamer” laptops usually have decent sound.Do you need amazing sound for parties or movies, or do you already have a great speaker you can plug in?
 

Step 2 → Let’s make the decision

Now that you know the basics, it’s time to decide. We’ve put together some simple questions; depending on your answers, we’d recommend one hardware spec over another:

Criterion 0: Set a budget

Time to define your budget! You can calculate how many days of work it takes to earn the cost of the computer. Ultimately, the decision will come down to this. This purchase can easily represent more than a month’s work, so it’s very important to be as informed as possible before you pull the trigger.

Criterion 1: Usage habits

Let’s look at the most important questions for defining your habits:

Do I need the computer to be portable, or will I use it in one place?
Will I use it for gaming and design, or just for office work?
How much information am I going to save?
Do I need to run several programs at the same time?

With these questions and your budget, you can narrow down your list of options. Choose wisely.

Don’t get fooled
It’s important to remember that when you go to a store, a salesperson usually tries to push the “star product.” However, computers from 6 months or a year ago are often significantly cheaper than the latest tech, while still being great. Sometimes, you can find a used computer that’s been well-cared for and get a great deal. Also, I’d recommend buying a desktop or a laptop that allows you to upgrade its hardware if possible.
The computer I’m writing this on, I bought 13 years ago. It’s had a hard drive swap and a RAM upgrade, plus a few repairs, but it still works great and has been a fantastic long-term investment.
Finally, remember that it’s very easy to find pages and people dedicated to writing reviews and evaluating computer performance. Some sites even let you compare options. Once you’ve picked out the computers on the market that fit your needs, use these sites and user comments to make a more accurate decision.
One last tip that never hurts: go by the reputation of the brand and the seller. From my experience, I recommend ASUS for value for money, though at SOLE, we’ve also had good luck with Lenovo.

How much is enough?
This is a tough one, but I think we can rephrase it: Does the option you chose meet the need and intention you started with? In my case, 13 years ago, I bought a computer for university, but I also wanted to play games and download/watch lots of movies. If I had gone with the bare minimum (just for university), I should have picked a lightweight laptop with good battery life, a small screen, a mid-range processor, 8GB of RAM, and a basic graphics card. Instead, I did the exact opposite: I bought a big, heavy computer with poor battery life and a dedicated graphics card—what you’d call a “gamer” laptop: the ASUS N53SV.
Because I didn’t think it through, I ended up with a computer that was too big and heavy to carry around, with a battery that died in no time. In the end, its main job was university work; the gaming and movies were secondary. Now, even though I still use it, I almost never move it. It basically became a desktop. That’s why, here at SOLE Voltaje, we don’t want you to make the same mistakes I did! Always remember that often, “less is more.”
With what we’ve covered, nobody can pull the wool over your eyes now—it’s time to make the call!

en/solve/solv-buy-phone-plan.title: How to buy the right cell phone plan for me?
en/solve/solv-buy-phone-plan.summary: A cell phone plan that fits your capabilities and needs.
en/solve/solv-buy-phone-plan.content:
Hi, I’m Nicolás, and just like you, I’ve been learning step-by-step how to improve my connectivity.
I’m no expert, but through searching on Internet →, tutorials, and above all, trial and error, I’ve learned a ton and set up functional solutions.
What does it mean to buy a cell phone plan that’s right for you?
Below, you’ll find a series of information, criteria, and tips that aim to be as clear as possible, so you can feel supported in making the decision about which Smartphone → plan to buy.
The estimated reading time is about 9 minutes and consists of 10 items, but don’t be scared; you can read these items with the help of others. Remember that at SOLE Voltaje, we want to promote the collective use of the internet.

What is this for?
In this solution, you’ll find a few practical tips to help you make a much more informed decision about which cell phone plans are best suited for you.

Before we start, some ethical considerations
At SOLE Voltaje, we like to clarify the ethical implications of the decisions we make, and we like to focus on the circumstances that lead you to make that decision. We often use uncomfortable questions to challenge ourselves.
Shall we play? You want to buy a cell phone plan with data, but do you really need it? Think about it; it might not be the best option for you.
Sometimes, you have free internet available at public libraries. Maybe you can use the WiFi Signal → from one of your neighbors, or you can buy a cell phone PIN to access the internet for a few hours.
If, after scanning your options, you definitely decide that you need to buy a cell phone plan, this is the right place for you! Here, we advise you on which prepaid and postpaid internet plans might be useful.

What do you need?

Money saved for the purchase
Information on available operators
A place where you can top up or subscribe to the plan
Curiosity


How to do it?

ALERT! Before starting: prepaid or postpaid?
To have clarity when reading this solution, we must first address some concepts. In this case, the difference between a postpaid and a prepaid plan.

























PrepaidPostpaidIt’s when the user pays for mobile services before using them.It’s when the user pays for mobile services after using them.You can top up whenever you want.You will have to pay your bill month by month.You can acquire your prepaid plan by subscription or on-demand.It helps build your credit history.You don’t receive any monthly bill.It grants you additional benefits like cheaper rates.
There is no absolute answer as to which type of service to choose. It depends on each person’s habits, possibilities, and needs.

Step 0 → How do I know if I need to buy a cell phone plan?

One of the characteristics of our current era is the great development of international and national markets. Our cell phones are made in China and we can buy them in Colombia; we can go to the market and buy rice brought from Brazil. Furthermore, we find disproportionate consumption options: we can buy white rice, yellow rice, bulk rice, lemon-flavored rice, etc.
There is an endless array of options to turn us into consumers of products that, many times, we don’t need. Thus, we end up buying non-nutritious food and falling into expenses that don’t satisfy the main function of eating.
Similarly, we fill our homes with endless merchandise that ends up piled up or discarded because, in the end, it was useless to us.
At SOLE Colombia, we want to promote responsible consumption.
Is choosing your data plan a responsible choice? We encourage you to answer the following questions:

Do you need to buy a cell phone plan, or do you have other options to access the internet?
Is there any other option that could cover your internet connection and be paid for by several people?
If you buy a cell phone plan, will it really improve your quality of life, or will it make it worse? How much time will you spend on social media? Will it be difficult for you to disconnect from the content? Will it imply a monthly dose of stress knowing how you will pay for this new expense?
Finally, is this new consumption really a priority for you? What real use will you give it?
Don’t forget this consideration: the decision you make can be reversible when conditions change. It’s not a child; it’s just a payment plan that you can change whenever and however you need.




Step 1 → What do I need a cell phone plan for?

Now that you’ve decided, it’s time to understand what you’re going to need it for.
Do you need the plan to facilitate your work, to study, to stay connected with your family and friends, or to spend leisure time? Depending on your answer, you will identify usage patterns.
Let’s use my case as an example:

💡 In 2022, I had two jobs and no office. Plus, I moved around a lot: I traveled through Bogotá and to different parts of the country on a recurring basis. I needed to connect to virtual meetings; one of my jobs required Zoom video calls. So, I needed a data connection and to make calls to many people. At that time, I decided to have a postpaid plan with 10 GB and unlimited minutes.
Shortly after, I started traveling and staying constantly at a family farm, where the data signal was very poor. I decided to buy a fixed internet plan for the farm.
In 2023, I only had one job and had an office with internet. I didn’t need to travel as much anymore. I changed my postpaid plan to a cheaper one and canceled the internet plan at the farm.

Now it’s your turn to identify what you need the internet plan for!


Step 2 → According to what you need, these are the questions to ask yourself.


Do you need minutes, data, or both?
Do you need a high connection speed to download heavy files or have video calls?
Do you need this service constantly, or is it only for a few days of the week?
Do you need coverage in several territories or just one?
What budget do you have available for this expense?




Step 3 → According to what is available, these are the questions to ask yourself

Now let’s take action! We need to get the following information:
Which mobile operators are available in my territory?

Ask your neighbors: what operator do they use or have they used in the past? Which one works best? Which one has better technical support? Which one has better rates?
You can go to the cell phone stores in the nearest urban center and ask directly about which operators they have available. In Colombia, for 2024, there are multiple options: Claro, Movistar, TIGO, WOM, Virgin Mobile, Avantel, and Móvil Éxito are the main operators in the market. The latter two are small operators that rent the infrastructure of the large operators to provide their services.

What plans do these operators have available?
After being clear about the operators available in your territory and knowing which ones perform best, proceed to ask about the prepaid and postpaid plans they offer. Below, we present some comparative tables of the prepaid and postpaid plans that were offered in 2023.
Prepaid plan rates 7-10 days

Selectra, What is the best prepaid cell phone plan in Colombia?


Step 4 → Evaluate which is the best option: What do I really need?**

It’s time to make a decision! With the information you gathered, we will give you some criteria that we consider fundamental when making a decision:

Frequency of use: how much are you going to use it?


Photo: Pixabay License
If, for example, most of your days you need to make calls and be connected to the internet, balancing it out, postpaid plans end up being the best option.
But if, on the other hand, your demand is occasional, has variability throughout the month, and/or you can be constantly connected to a WiFi network at your workplace or home, making sporadic prepaid top-ups might be the most useful.

Budget: how much money do you want to spend?

Now it’s time to define a budget! An easy calculation: how many hours of work per week does this new consumption represent? This can become a permanent expense, so it is important to reason through the purchase.
The final decision may fall on this point: people who use prepaid plans usually don’t have a constant flow of money that ensures they can pay a monthly fee. While the use of postpaid is associated with people who can guarantee the payment of a monthly fee constantly.
Currently, prepaid top-ups in the Colombian market start from $2,000 COP with one day of validity. On the other hand, the cheapest postpaid plans are around $27,000 COP per month.
To make this decision, take a count of how much you are willing to invest in this service and what your frequency of use is.

Usage habits: what and how are you going to use it for?

Are you a person who makes long-duration calls, or do you spend more time connected to the internet? Depending on this, you will be able to prioritize the number of minutes, the number of Gigabytes, or both, when choosing your consumption option.
Below, we explain each of these variables if you are still not very clear about how they work:













MinutesDataThe minutes associated with your plan determine how long you can spend talking to other mobile phones nationwide; in some cases, a number of minutes to other countries like Venezuela, Canada, or the United States is also included. Currently, most postpaid plans come with unlimited minutes.They are the amount of mobile data intended for internet use on your phone. Their use is the amount your cell phone uploads or downloads when using them. You can configure them to not spend them, save them, or restrict what they are used for. Remember that depending on the content you upload or download, the data consumption will be higher or lower; for example, watching a two-hour movie from your cell phone can consume approximately 300 MB, almost a third of a Gigabyte. Content like videos, audio, or high-resolution images has high data consumption compared to other types of files like text.

Photo: CC0 Public Domain,
For example, when we do SOLE, we need to connect a few computers to be able to research Big Questions. That means that the plan we contract must necessarily have data.
You can make your phone’s internet connection available to the group so that everyone can use it.
Although the internet searches that take place in a SOLE don’t use much data, you might want to watch videos or other content that requires a larger amount of data than you have contracted. However, you don’t need that amount of data available all the time.
So you can buy a prepaid plan that allows you to be connected, specifically for the SOLE, and solve your Big Questions.
If you decide to meet once a week or want to have the space available with the connection at any time, you can consider paying for a postpaid plan together… how does that sound?

Signal: where are you going to use it?

We have to look at coverage, upload and download speed, 3G, 4G signal.
Although we often hear people say that one operator is better than another, this will depend on the region and can change over time.
Sometimes they install more antennas → or their networks become saturated due to an excess of users.

Other benefits: information that may be useful


Watch out for “Free data usage in apps”
Remember, nothing is free!

Most plans currently in Colombia have the use of applications like Facebook or WhatsApp “unlimited” as long as the top-up lasts or for the whole month in the case of postpaid plans.
They never explain to us that this unlimited consumption is only related to messages that contain text; that is, if you view a photo or a video via WhatsApp or Facebook, the data associated with this consumption will be deducted from your plan.

‘Free’ applications

Some postpaid plans offer us a license for applications like Amazon Prime (series and movie platform) or Spotify (music streaming application); that is, for the payment of a cell phone plan, they give you access to the Premium version of these platforms. This can be beneficial if they are platforms you already use; if not, ignore it, it will be one more expense.
They also don’t tell you that this way of ‘forcing’ you to use certain applications to communicate, entertain yourself, inform yourself, or create your digital presence is part of a commercial strategy. That is, companies will use the information from your profiles to offer you consumer goods, which will redound to the benefit of the corporations responsible for their processing… that is, those companies are profiting from the information they extract about you. So, watch out: when a product is free, it’s because you are the product.

Don’t let yourself be fooled
It is important that you constantly check the plans and offers of the operators.
Currently, in Colombia, you can do “portability,” that is, switch from one operator to another, change from one operator’s plan to another while keeping your number, just by requesting the new operator to carry out this process. There are no longer any permanence clauses that force you to stay with the same operator for a specific time. So if you see that there is a better option for you, don’t hesitate to do portability!
There is a small offer available from small operators; these are prepaid plans with long validity periods.
I, who live in Bogotá, am evaluating switching to Móvil Éxito. Currently, I have a postpaid plan at WOM where I pay $40,000 COP; this entitles me to 60 GB and unlimited minutes—that’s a lot! Initially, I switched to WOM because, by doing portability, they gave me the first three months free, plus 20 GB, and they charged me $35,000 COP. Now that I’m in Bogotá and work from home and the office, I have internet available from these places. I was checking options while writing this solution and saw that Móvil Éxito offers the following prepaid plans:

Per month, my consumption does not exceed 5 GB and I make, at most, 30 calls a month. For this reason, the first plan would cost me $13,000 COP, less than a third of what I pay now! Mind you, I have to make the payment for the whole year at once, but I am not tied to any type of contract.

How much is enough?
This question is difficult to answer, but I think we can rephrase it as follows: does the option you chose meet the need and intention you projected at the beginning?
In the previous example, I showed you how I consider the plan I currently have to be excessive, and I found options that do meet my initial requirement at a third of the price I currently pay.
These types of reasoning are what we would like you to have when making a decision about the option you are going to buy.

en/solve/solv-buy-satellite-antenna.title: How to buy a satellite antenna?
en/solve/solv-buy-satellite-antenna.summary: Choose an internet service for places with zero connection.
en/solve/solv-buy-satellite-antenna.content:
Photo: Satellite antenna - Wikipedia
Hi, I’m Nicolás and I’m learning about how the internet works. I’m no expert, but through online searches, tutorials, and above all, a lot of curiosity, I’ve learned how to set up functional internet solutions.
What does choosing an internet service for unconnected areas mean?
In this specific solution, we will learn how to choose a satellite internet service for rural or remote areas that don’t have Wi-Fi or wired internet connections. To do this, we’ll look at three technologies available in Colombia: Satellite dish, WiMax, and Starlink.

What is it for?
This solution helps you get a clearer picture of which satellite internet service you can choose if you are located in areas without Wi-Fi or wired internet connections.

How do I know if I need it?
Well, the quality of the internet service you can choose will depend on your possibilities and needs, as well as the availability of internet providers in your region.
This solution is an option you can pay for together with the people in the community where you live. Consult with others to reach a common criteria and decide together; sharing the decision, maintenance, costs, benefits, and advantages of the services will make the decision you take more sustainable and long-lasting in the long run.

What do you need?

A budget, meaning knowing what you can afford to spend
A list of internet providers in your region
Lots of curiosity!
It can help to have key people in your community to review the information with; making a decision together will be easier and more beneficial for everyone


How to do it?

Step 0 → What types of internet connections work in unconnected regions?

Now let’s get down to business. Digital technologies change rapidly over the years. In this article, we want to present our research on the options available in Colombia for 2024: satellite dish, WiMax, and Starlink.

Satellite dish


The most popular internet option for rural or remote areas these days is the satellite dish. The great advantage of this solution is its coverage, accessibility, and price, which makes it a viable and functional option. To access this technology, the company in charge will need to install a satellite dish at your home.

WiMax


Image: Alvarion WiMAX CPE Equipment - Wikipedia
The first thing you need is to contact a company that offers these services and has a repeater near your home to send you the internet signal. Afterward, you have to put an antenna on the facade of your house. This antenna will need to point directly at the company’s repeater providing the service or at an intermediate connection point used to bypass obstacles between your antenna and their repeater. The antenna installation will be done by the company itself.

Starlink


Image: Starlink Standard Actuated Antenna - Starlink
Starlink is Elon Musk’s satellite internet project. It is a private satellite internet service that facilitates connections, especially in rural areas. The company is considered the world’s first and largest satellite constellation using a low Earth orbit to provide high-speed, low-latency broadband satellite internet, which allows for streaming content, online gaming, video calls, and more.
To get it up and running, you must buy a kit with an antenna that should be placed outside your home; it orients itself automatically to establish a connection in a matter of minutes, provided you have a clear view of the sky.
Now that we have an introduction to the available options, we can move on to moment 1, where we will talk about the pros and cons of each option.


Step 1 → Pros and cons of a satellite dish connection

Pros

Global coverage: This means that people living in remote regions or rural areas can access the internet reliably.
Fast access: Faster than DSL and dial-up services, with speeds between 25 Mbps and 100 Mbps. While satellite internet used to have a reputation for being slow, nowadays it is possible to enjoy speeds comparable to terrestrial connections.
Constant connectivity: One of the most notable advantages of a satellite dish is its ability to provide a constant and stable connection. Unlike terrestrial connections that can be affected by infrastructure interruptions or adverse weather conditions, satellite internet does not depend on physical cables and relies on satellites in orbit for data transmission. This ensures a reliable and continuous connection, even in areas prone to natural disasters.
High flexibility and mobility: Satellite internet also offers flexibility and mobility. You can have internet access from anywhere covered by the satellite signal, making it an ideal option for people who travel frequently, remote workers, or those who need connectivity in temporary or expanding areas.
No residential phone service needed: Having a phone line is not a requirement to access this internet service.

Cons

High latency →: One of the main disadvantages of a satellite dish is the latency →, that is, the time it takes for the signal to travel from the satellite to Earth. Due to the distance the signal must travel, latency can be higher compared to terrestrial connections. This can affect real-time activities, such as video conferencing or online gaming, where even small delays can be noticeable.
High cost: Satellite internet tends to be more expensive compared to other connectivity options. Service prices are higher than other types of internet due to the high costs of equipment, operation, and satellites.
Weather conditions: The proper functioning of satellite internet can depend on good weather conditions. For the use of a satellite dish, a clear sky is needed. Signal stability could be compromised by rain or thunderstorms.
Data limitations: Many satellite internet providers apply monthly data caps to their plans. This means that users have a limited amount of data they can download and upload during a given period. If this limit is exceeded, the speed may be reduced or additional charges may apply.




Step 2 → Pros and cons of a WiMax connection

Pros

High fluidity and low latency: This allows for a fast and fluid connection with low latency.
No residential phone service needed: Having a phone line is not a requirement to access the internet service.
VoIP calls: There will be companies that, with the installation of this technology, will allow you to make VoIP calls (a technology that allows you to make and receive voice calls over the internet).

Cons

Direct contact with the repeater is necessary: This means that the antenna you install at your home must be oriented directly toward the site from where the connection is being sent, and if possible, avoiding obstacles that block direct line-of-sight, such as trees or buildings. This can sometimes make it necessary to install intermediate connection points to bypass obstacles.
Asymmetric speeds: This means that the download speed will be much higher than the upload speed. WiMAX connections can reach speeds of up to 1Gbps at fixed points, for example, a house, and 365Mbps at mobile points. Even so, it will always depend on what the company you hire offers you.
Congestion traffic: Speed could be affected more easily during peak hours.




Step 3 → Pros and cons of a Starlink connection

Pros

Easy installation: The user buys a kit and can set it up independently.
High fluidity and low latency: High-speed, low-latency broadband internet. It will have latencies of around 20ms, compared to the average of 600ms.
High flexibility and mobility: Starlink also offers flexibility and mobility. You can have internet access from anywhere covered by the satellite signal, making it an ideal option for people who travel frequently, remote workers, or those who need connectivity in temporary or expanding areas.
Possibility of a full refund of equipment cost in the first month: If you purchase the service directly from Starlink, there is this possibility: “Try it for 30 days and, if you are not satisfied, return the equipment and get a full refund,” says Starlink on its website.

Cons

Weather conditions: The proper functioning of satellite internet can depend on good weather conditions. For the use of a satellite dish, a clear sky is needed. Signal stability could be compromised by rain or thunderstorms.
High cost: Starlink’s satellite internet tends to be more expensive compared to other connectivity options. This is due to the high costs associated with launching and maintaining satellites, as well as the infrastructure required on Earth for ground stations to function. The cost of this service is $300,000 COP per month with a one-time payment for the equipment of $1,900,000 COP.
Capacity limitations: Since the Starlink system relies on satellites in low orbit, capacity is limited and shared among users in a given area. In congested areas, this could result in reduced speed during peak hours.
Interference issues: Some reports suggest that Starlink may experience interference issues, especially in densely populated areas or regions with high satellite activity.
Environmental impact: The deployment of thousands of satellites in low orbit has raised concerns about the environmental impact and the generation of space debris.
Need for direct view of the sky: To use Starlink, it is necessary to have a direct view of the sky, which can limit its viability in areas with significant obstructions like tall trees or buildings.




Step 4 → How to choose the best option for my community?

Now that you have a clearer idea of what each of the three options consists of, along with their pros and cons, you can make a more informed decision together with your community. We consider the following to be important elements when choosing an option:


Availability
Although we conducted this analysis in 2024 for Colombia, it may be useful for other countries. However, the first step is to contact the companies that offer internet services in your region; they will be able to guide you better and tell you if they offer WiMax technology. But remember, their interest is to sell, but you are the one who decides. Satellite internet and Starlink have global coverage, so they won’t depend exclusively on providers in your region.


Budget
Above all, define what your budget will be. To do this, you can calculate how many days of work you are willing to invest together with your community to hire this service. Don’t go into debt for an internet plan!



Photo: Maxi Gagliano - Pexels


Reliability
It is important to know if the company you selected has a good reputation or not. You can find this out from other users who have hired them, and it will be vital if you have any issues or need to perform any kind of equipment maintenance.


Usage habits
Depending on what your community uses the internet for, you can choose a technology that benefits you more. Here you can evaluate if latency is important because you need to make video calls or play online, if you are willing to hire a monthly paid service, or if, simply because the use is occasional, you only pay for the internet service in the months of highest use, or if these options are simply not the most suitable and you prefer to continue without an internet connection.



Don’t get fooled
Define your usage and number of devices to estimate the speed and Bandwidth → needed, and then evaluate the available technology (satellite is a common option) and the reliability and technical support of the provider.
Research the provider’s reputation with neighbors and ask if they offer specific plans for rural areas. The upload speed, download speed, and latency must be adequate for your activities, and it is useful to ask about data restrictions and the quality of the provider’s infrastructure.

How much is enough?
One of these three solutions might be the right one to solve connectivity in your region, as they are all designed for places far from cities and do not depend on a wired internet service to function.
You can keep the following criteria in mind and think about them in terms of the people and the content you need to access:

For basic use (emails, social media, browsing): A moderate download speed and a basic data plan might be enough.
For streaming and online work: A higher download speed and greater bandwidth are required to avoid interruptions.
For intensive upload use (cloud, large files): It is important to look for a symmetric connection, where the upload speed is close to the download speed.

en/solve/solv-choose-satellite-internet.title: Which satellite internet should I choose based on my needs?
en/solve/solv-choose-satellite-internet.summary: Invest your money wisely to install satellite internet.
en/solve/solv-choose-satellite-internet.content:
Hi, I’m Nicolás, and just like you, I’ve been learning how to improve my internet connection. I’m no expert, but by searching around, following tutorials, and learning through trial and error, I’ve managed to improve internet quality in places that don’t have great connectivity.
In this specific solution, we’ll figure out the criteria for choosing which satellite internet best fits our connectivity needs. We’ll also face some ethical questions that might influence our choice.
Our advice: decide with both your head and your heart—choose the option that best serves your needs and those of your community.
What does it mean to choose satellite internet with criteria?
Satellite internet is a technology designed to send an internet signal from a satellite in orbit to a satellite dish at your home or business.
With satellite internet, you can connect computers, smartphones →, tablets, and more. This technology doesn’t require the cabling used by, for example, fiber-optic internet.

What is it for?
This solution is here to help you decide which satellite internet is worth buying if you’re located in a place without an internet connection.
In this guide, we’ll cover the pros and cons of three different solutions so you can make a conscious and responsible decision: satellite dish, WiMax, or Starlink.
Before you start, we suggest that if you decide to buy any of the options presented here, you try to split the cost with others so you can enjoy the internet as a community.

Before we begin, some ethical questions
Do you believe that everyone, regardless of where they are, should have access to the internet? In Colombia, for example, a 2021 legislative act established and elevated the internet to a fundamental right, making it an obligation to expand internet coverage to unconnected communities and territories. Meanwhile, international organizations like the UN state that denying internet access is like denying the right to freedom of expression.
This might sound great, but the reality is complex and unequal. On one hand, not everyone has internet: nearly a third of the world’s population remains offline—about 2.6 billion people. Internet service providers aren’t keen on reaching places without infrastructure because the potential for profit is lower. This widens and maintains the inequity in internet access. On the other hand, the deployment of thousands of satellites in low Earth orbit has raised concerns about environmental impact and the creation of space debris.
So, at SOLE Colombia, we see satellite internet as one of the available options, specifically designed for places that don’t have an internet connection or nearby telecommunications towers to distribute it. If that’s not your case, you might find a more conscious solution tailored to your needs elsewhere in this guide.

How do I know if I need this solution?
Before we start, we’d like to ask you a few questions:

Do you currently have fiber-optic or mobile internet of fair or good quality?
Where you live, can you see telecommunications towers that distribute internet?
Are there companies that can offer you an internet service at a reasonable cost?

If you answered “yes” to any of these questions, we recommend sticking with your mobile or fiber-optic internet and looking for other solutions on SOLE Voltaje → that might help you improve your connection. But don’t go yet! We invite you to keep reading this guide so you can learn more about satellite internet and make your own informed decisions.
If, on the other hand, you answered “no” to all the questions above, you have a poor internet connection, and you’ve already checked out other solutions, we invite you to keep reading.

Options to review
In this solution, we will look at three technologies available in Colombia as of 2024: Satellite Internet, WiMax, and Starlink. The estimated reading time for this solution is about 15 minutes, but don’t be intimidated—you can read these recommendations with the help of others. Remember, at SOLE Voltaje, we want to promote the collective use of the internet.

Satellite Internet
The most popular option for internet in rural areas is satellite internet. Although the name is self-explanatory, it involves connecting to the internet via satellites. The great advantage of this option is that it can reach anywhere, including the most remote rural areas! To access this technology, the company will need to install a satellite dish at your home.



WiMax
How WiMAX works is simple: it acts as a repeater for the company you hire, emitting microwave signals that reach your antenna. Therefore, the first thing you need to do is contact a company that offers these services and has a repeater near your home to send you the signal. Then, you have to mount an antenna on the facade of your house. This antenna must point directly at the service provider’s repeater or at an intermediate connection point used to bypass obstacles between your antenna and their repeater. The company itself will handle the antenna installation.


_Image taken from Wikipedia

Starlink
Starlink is Elon Musk’s satellite internet project. It is a private satellite internet service that facilitates connections, especially in rural areas. The company is considered the world’s first and largest satellite constellation using a low Earth orbit to offer broadband satellite internet with high speed and low latency. This allows for streaming content, online gaming, video calls, and more.

To get it running, the user buys a kit with everything needed, most notably the antenna, which must be placed outdoors. It automatically orients itself to establish a connection in a matter of minutes, provided it has a clear view of the sky.

_Image taken from Starlink

Now that we have an introduction to the available options, let’s get to the part where you learn the criteria you should keep in mind to choose the option that suits you best.

What should I keep in mind to make this decision?
Availability: Are these options available where I live?
Although we conducted this analysis in 2024 for Colombia, it may be useful for other countries. To know the availability of these three options, keep in mind that, unlike WiMax, Satellite Internet and Starlink have global coverage, so they don’t depend exclusively on local providers. For the WiMax option, the first thing you must do is contact the companies offering internet services in your region; they will be able to guide you and tell you if they actually offer this technology.
Budget: How much can I afford?

The cost of WiMax service can start from $150,000 COP per month, with a payment for equipment between $300,000 COP and $2,000,000 COP, depending on the company you choose.
The cost of satellite internet service can start from $150,000 COP per month, with a payment for equipment between $300,000 COP and $2,000,000 COP, depending on the company you choose.
The cost of Starlink service can start from $180,000 COP per month, with a one-time equipment fee of $1,900,000 COP.

Weather conditions: Can the weather affect the internet signal?

For Starlink and Satellite Internet, the quality of the internet will depend on weather conditions. Using a satellite dish requires a clear sky; for this reason, signal stability could be compromised by rain or thunderstorms.
For WiMax, keep in mind that a direct line of sight to the repeater is necessary. This means the antenna you install at home must be oriented directly toward the site sending the connection, ideally avoiding obstacles that block the line of sight, such as trees or buildings. Sometimes, it may be necessary to install intermediate connection points to bypass obstacles.

Signal and coverage: Which option offers the best quality?

The advantage of Satellite Internet is that it has global coverage, meaning people living in remote regions or rural areas can access the internet reliably. One of the most notable advantages of satellite internet is its ability to provide a constant and stable connection. Unlike terrestrial connections, which can be affected by infrastructure interruptions or adverse weather conditions, satellite internet doesn’t rely on cables. This ensures a reliable and continuous connection, even in areas prone to natural disasters.
However, the downside of satellite internet is that many providers offer a limited amount of data that can be downloaded and uploaded over a certain period. If this limit is exceeded, speeds may be throttled, or additional charges may apply.
For WiMax, the advantage is that it doesn’t require a residential telephone service. Having a landline is not a requirement to access the internet service.
On the downside, the download speed will be much higher than the upload speed. WiMAX connections can reach speeds of up to 1Gbps at fixed points (like a house) and 365Mbps at mobile points. Even so, it will always depend on what the company you hire offers. Also, keep in mind that speed could be more easily affected during peak hours.
For its part, Starlink offers an easy installation that you and your community can carry out: the company provides the user with a kit including the necessary instructions for assembly. Starlink also offers flexibility and mobility. You can have internet access from anywhere covered by the satellite signal, making it an ideal option for people who travel frequently, remote workers, or those who need connectivity in temporary or expanding areas.
However, since the Starlink system relies on satellites in low orbit, capacity is limited and shared among users in a given area. In congested areas, this could result in reduced speeds during peak hours, although its coverage is constantly improving. Some reports suggest that Starlink can experience interference issues, especially in densely populated areas or regions with high satellite activity. For this reason, keep in mind that using Starlink requires a direct view of the sky, which may limit its viability in areas with significant obstructions like tall trees or buildings.

What signal speed do I need?
By latency →, we refer to the time it takes for the signal to travel from the satellite to Earth. For Starlink, the broadband internet is high-speed with low latency. It will have latencies of around 20ms, compared to the average of 600ms.
For its part, WiMax allows for a fast and fluid connection with low latency.
However, the speed of satellite internet can be lower compared to terrestrial connections. This can affect real-time activities like video conferencing or online gaming, where even small delays can be noticeable.

en/solve/solv-community-meeting-space.title: How to get a community hall or any community space to use the internet as a group?
en/solve/solv-community-meeting-space.content:
Hi, I’m Manu. As a SOLE Explorer, I’ve had to learn how to request community spaces in the places where we’ve gone to host SOLEs, and I know it’s not always easy to know where to start.

What does it mean to ask for a community hall, or any community space?
This is a solution that guides you on how to reserve a common space to use the Internet as a group, or for whatever else you want to do in that space. Remember that each space has its own rules and application procedures, so this solution can guide you on the criteria, but it isn’t a definitive rulebook.
If you have any tips on how you do it in your community that you think might help others, I invite you to comment on this solution—we create the Internet together!

What is it for?
At SOLE Colombia, we believe things are more fun when we do them together. Community halls are spaces for us to meet others, to connect, to celebrate, to share, and you can use them too.
Here, I’ll tell you some steps you can follow to reserve the community hall closest to you. Good luck!

What do you need?

A good attitude; believe in yourself.
An ID document to sign the reservation (optional).
A letter to request the reservation of the space (optional).


How to do it?

Step 1 → Discover the place and head over there

Once you decide where you want to hold your activity, go to the community hall and talk to the people in charge.
Introduce yourself and tell them why you want to use the space, what it’s for, and how many people have confirmed.
Encourage them to participate in your activity as well; for example, if you are going to host a SOLE, you can invite them to become participants.



Step 2 → Ask about the requirements, what you need to formalize the request


Once you are in contact with the people in charge, ask them about the availability of the place and what requirements you need, or how you can reserve it.


Step 3 → Write the reservation letter or meet the place’s requirements

Usually, community halls require a letter to reserve the space.
Write down what the activity will consist of, when it will take place, and who the organizers and participants will be.
Also, it is very important that you include your contact details; they will need them to confirm if it is possible for your activity to take place at the time you have planned.
We also advise you to include a few words of thanks for the authorization to use the space.
You may need to attach a photocopy of your ID, so keep that in mind.
Do you think an example could help? Here are the steps to keep in mind and what the example would look like:

Include the place and date where you are.
Address the letter to the name or title of the person or entity that owns or manages the space.
Introduce yourself as the person responsible for the request or the organization of the activity.
Explain the purpose of the activity and its details. You can also request items you need to carry out your activity, for example, chairs, tables, computers, or other items you require that are available to the person lending you the hall.
Thank them for their attention and inform them how they can respond to you. It could be your phone number or another way to contact you.
Finally, sign the letter.

This is what this written formula would look like:


💡 El Montecillo Village
Municipality of Arracachal
February 13, 2038
Good morning,
My name is (your full name), I am identified with ID No. (ID Number), and I am contacting you to request the use of the (name of the space or meeting hall) to carry out an activity in the company of members of the community.
My idea is to use the space to learn, dialogue, and solve some challenges in my community that we will identify during the meeting, using the Internet as a group.
The meeting details are:

Date: (day of the week), (day) of (month) of (year)
Time: at (time)
Number of people: (number) people will be meeting
Duration of the meeting: (time)

To carry out the activity, we need some conditions and furniture: one chair per person, some tables where we can place some computers, and the possibility of plugging them in (so they don’t run out of battery). It is also necessary to have electricity and an Internet connection available.
We commit to taking care of the common space and complying with the rules of use in this space that belongs to everyone.
You can contact me at (phone number) or through (other contact method).
Thank you very much for your attention, I look forward to hearing from you.
(Name of the person signing).



Remember that this is just an example; you can draft the letter however you like. Don’t forget to ask the person in charge what information, data, or attachments you must include in the document.


Step 4 → Ask for a contact to follow up and request confirmation; don’t wait too long

It may happen that your confirmation needs to go through some filters or that the process takes a while. Although you shouldn’t lose your cool, it doesn’t hurt to ask for the contact person’s details to follow up on the process, so you can ensure you can plan and make your activity a reality within the deadlines you had in mind.


Step 5 → Thank them for the help and celebrate; you’ve found an ally in your community!

Once they confirm that you can use the space, don’t forget to thank the person in charge with whom you were in contact from the beginning.
You can send them an email, a WhatsApp message, or greet them on the street, reminding them how important their support was in making the activity happen. They are a good ally for future occasions when you want to use the community hall again.

You can share your experience reserving the community hall in your village, neighborhood, or housing complex with others :) Remember that learning in a group is very powerful, and your experience can help or inspire others!

How to know if this solution works?
Once you have your space reserved, it’s just a matter of iterating the process as many times as you need. Perhaps you can make a broader request that lasts longer. For this, it can be useful to leverage the good news, findings, and successes of the activity you have proposed in the space and how it is bearing fruit in the community.
For example, when you manage to get a group of people to do SOLEs recurrently, you will be able to verify the benefits it has for skills like communication, negotiation, reading comprehension, digital competencies, autonomy, leadership… making a small report, for example, with the result of the Reflection capsules (available on the SOLE Colombia website n9.cl/reflexionatusole), can be very powerful to strengthen the relationship with your ally and with the people in your community.

Other possible Internets
Sometimes, the paperwork involving large entities, or that involves the decision of many people, can take time. It is important that, at the time of the request, you are clear about the deadlines and can set reminders to follow up on your request.
Often, it is enough to remind the person with whom you made the request, stop by to say hello kindly, and remind them that you are waiting for an answer. They will appreciate your attention and will surely put more care into giving you an answer.

en/solve/solv-create-poweful-message.title: How to mobilize others for your cause?
en/solve/solv-create-poweful-message.summary: Create a powerful message so that others connect with your purpose.
en/solve/solv-create-poweful-message.content:
Hi! I’m Manu, the storyteller for SOLE Colombia, and today I want to talk to you about the power of a message.
If you’re here, it’s because you want to learn how to mobilize others for your cause and build a powerful message. Shall we do it together?
What does it mean to create a powerful message?
In this solution, we’re going to dive into a very special methodology in the world of storytelling: the Golden Circle, created by Simon Sinek. We will use this methodology step-by-step to help you develop a clear and powerful message.
Through the three fundamental questions Sinek proposes, I will guide you to unravel the message behind your cause. When you rally others with a clear and powerful message, you make them feel deeply connected to you.
Get ready, because this is going to be exciting!

What is it for?
Creating a powerful message, focused on your purpose, means connecting emotionally with your audience and inspiring them to take action. It serves to inspire others, appealing to their emotions and values to create a deeper and more meaningful connection. You will create more coherent and consistent communication.

What do you need?

Paper.
A pen/pencil or any digital tool.
And, of course, enthusiasm.


How to do it?

file.notion.so/f/f/d2a8cf29-6055-4dd9-8971-801014f46b2a/a6e3ad9c-19b6-46e9-8ef3-2184ad609e21/Vdeo_sin_ttulo__Hecho_con_Clipchamp_(5).mp4?table=block&id=12a2bd68-c5b6-81cc-a580-d32a8d9dbe02&spaceId=d2a8cf29-6055-4dd9-8971-801014f46b2a&expirationTimestamp=1764108000000&signature=cF6F8pUItq0BKbFpFL9XY_q_cAeRXqgTtKC6-I3s08Q&downloadName=V%C3%ADdeo+sin+t%C3%ADtulo+%E2%80%90+Hecho+con+Clipchamp+%285%29.mp4

Step 1 → Start with the what

What is it that you do or want to do? What do you want to share or offer the world? That is the “what” of your message. Starting with the what will help you glimpse your why more easily.
Here, your ideas take shape and become tangible actions: a product, a service, or an offer.
Activity: To discover it, I invite you to write on a blank sheet of paper what you are doing or offering in tangible terms… A SOLE? An activity? A product?
If you still have doubts, use the examples to start your golden circle. Go for it!


Step 2 → Define the how

We’re on the right track! With your purpose clear, the rest will follow… Now that you know the flame that drives you, it’s time to think about how to fuel it and bring your message to the world. What strategies, actions, or methods will you use to make your why shine?
The time has come to determine the methods and processes you will use to carry out your “what.” For this step, you need to know how you do what you do to fulfill your motivation. Think about whether it’s a format that makes you unique, a product no one else had thought of, or an original service you offer. Here, the qualities are what matter.
Activity:

Write a list on a sheet of paper of the activities you do to fulfill your “what” and select the ones you find most relevant.
Now put them all in one place and draft your how.

See how I did it to guide you:



Step 3 → Give shape to your why

To finish, it is necessary that you have a clear understanding of the fundamental purpose behind the message. What is the inspiring reason that motivates you?
When we are clear about our “why,” we create an emotional bond with our audience, sparking their interest and commitment on a deeper level.
Activity: To discover the why of your message, grab a blank sheet of paper and write down the first thing that comes to your head. Don’t overthink it. It’s okay if it’s just a few words; little by little, they will take shape 😉 This is how my why turned out:

Tip: Think about what motivates you to do what you are doing, and you’ll see that the words will appear little by little.

How do you know if this solution works?
There you have it; you have your why ready, and thus your message is much more powerful. Now you can have more clarity when you want to infect others with your purpose or that of your product. Remember, the most important thing is that it be authentic, that it reflects your essence, and that it makes you feel identified.
Now it’s your time to shine! Go ahead, conquer the world with your message! 🚀 Show us in the comments what your Golden Circle looks like!

Other possible Internets
Your message must reflect your purpose, that which drives you to action. It must be authentic and resonate with the people who listen to you.
Aligning your messages and your actions with your purpose makes communication coherent—take care of it. If your message is genuine, authentic, and reflects your true passion, you will be honoring your why.
It is very important that your message creates an emotional connection with the recipient; remember that only when we create emotional bonds with others do we manage to have words truly touch the hearts of others.
Remember! The goal of a powerful message is to motivate others to do something, to take action, and to follow you, be inspired, connect, and be motivated to follow your vision.

en/solve/solv-discover-audience.title: How to reach the people who will value your message the most?
en/solve/solv-discover-audience.content:
Hi there! 😊
I’m Manu, and I was a storyteller at SOLE Colombia for several years. Among all the stories I’m always telling, I always keep in mind who I’m directing my message to… have you ever wondered how to really reach the people who will value your message the most, or who will get involved in your projects?
In this solution, we’re going to discover your audience together. Are you ready?
What is discovering your audience?
Knowing your audience means deeply understanding who the people you’re directing your content to actually are. When you know your audience, you can focus your efforts where you know they’ll have an impact. What good is it to send an email blast if what you really want is to invite your family?
Knowing your audience is knowing by heart the shortest path to reach your people’s hearts and connecting with the right folks so your message can go further.

What is it for?
When you know who you’re talking to and you know them well, it allows you to adapt your message, tone, and communication style so that it resonates with the people you’re addressing, and what you say hits home with them.
You’ll create content that is more relevant to those people, tailored to their interests and needs, and that is useful, interesting, and valuable to them… without a doubt, you’ll improve how they perceive you, but most importantly, you’ll be able to create genuine and authentic connections because your message will go straight to their hearts.

What do you need?

Paper
Pen/Pencil
Enthusiasm
Cell phone or computer (to write and carry out the activities)


How to do it?

Step 1 → Define your ‘target audience’ in detail

Before you start, clearly establish who the people are that you want to reach with your message or call to action… Think about the key characteristics of the people you want to reach.
Grab your pencil or pen and answer on a sheet of paper:

What are your audience’s interests, needs, or challenges?
What kind of people would be most interested in what you have to offer?

See how I did with this exercise:



Step 2 → Create your characters, dig deep to create your ideal persona

Keeping the answers to the questions below in mind, create detailed profiles of your target audience. This will help you visualize and better understand who you’re talking to and what motivates them.

Discover their characteristics: write down the basic qualities of your ideal audience, such as age, gender, geographic location, education level, etc.
Interests and motivations: describe what motivates or interests these people; what are they looking for or what do they need?
Behaviors and preferences: where do they usually spend their time? What kind of content do they consume or what activities do they enjoy?
Challenges: what are the things preventing them from getting where they want to go or where you want to invite them? What are the hurdles they face?

When you’ve finished this exercise, it will be easier to visualize your ideal audience. See how I did it:



Step 3 → Observe and listen to your people, look for answers

Now that you have a clear idea of who your potential participants are, it’s time to observe and listen.

Start interacting with your potential audience through surveys, interviews, or simply by observing their interactions online.
Jot down any responses, comments, or patterns that help you better understand their needs and preferences, and spread your message while keeping their reactions or behaviors in mind.



How do you know if this solution is working?
It’s very important that you come up with ways to analyze how your audience lets you know that you’re reaching them. How can you tell?
Observe: how do the people who interact with your messages behave? Talk to them directly, invent easy ways to collect data on their experiences, opinions, and expectations… you can design a survey or form to get more data and be able to process it statistically.
Looking for patterns, trends, and motivations can lead you to more qualitative analyses, where you can find more complex and interesting explanations about your audience.
It’s exciting to find the best way to communicate with the people you want to reach! Constantly ask yourself questions about them so you can communicate better and better.
Is it working for you? Write to me and let me know!

Other possible Internets
Often, as you better define your audience, you realize that there are subgroups you want to approach, and you necessarily have to do it differently.
For example, at SOLE Colombia, we have a very large community with different ‘characters’ we speak to. We can’t talk to the Grandmas the same way we talk to the Tinkerer-types (Cacharreros), because it simply wouldn’t work. The content we create aims to make room for all of them, but we direct specific messages to each group, building community from the care we give to each collective.
That’s what we do! We really mull over our ways of communicating and the audiences we’re discovering. Experimenting continuously. Adapting to our findings. And doing it all over again. Many times. To connect more and more with people.
Now it’s your turn! Go for it, it’s fun!

en/solve/solv-donated-equipment.title: How to get donated equipment?
en/solve/solv-donated-equipment.summary: Giving a second use to equipment that would otherwise be discarded.
en/solve/solv-donated-equipment.content:
Hello, are you there? My name is Mateo and I’ll be joining you in developing this solution. If you are reading, listening to, or watching this, it’s because you’re interested or curious about how to get donated equipment. If that’s the case, you’re in the right place.

What is getting donated equipment?
In a nutshell, this solution is about reuse. It’s about being consistent with caring for the world we live in; it’s about taking advantage of things that are obsolete to others, but that we might be able to use for a long time to come.
This solution is for giving a second chance to equipment that is no longer needed. Did you know there are companies that want to upgrade their gear and donate what they have? This equipment is usually in good condition and your community could put it to good use.

What is this solution for?
While this solution doesn’t require money to purchase equipment, keep in mind that it can take weeks, or even months, depending on the steps we’ll share below. You have a better chance of receiving a donation if you can demonstrate that the equipment will be used for community purposes and that its goal is to improve people’s quality of life.

What do you need?

Persistence.
Patience.
Support from others. Teamwork increases your chances of success.


How to do it?
Let’s get started!
This solution is developed in three steps where we’ll share everything we know and have learned at Fundación SOLE Colombia about how to get donated equipment. Every case is different, so it’s important that you’re willing to adapt these steps depending on the hurdles you find along the way.

Photo: veerasak Piyawatanakul - Pexels


Step 1 → Find the donor company and identify the relationship model

Generally, equipment donors are companies with significant financial capacity, payroll, and infrastructure. Think of telecommunications or computer companies, universities, or look into sponsors of social projects in your region. That said, we suggest starting with smaller companies. You have two options for this:

Option 1: Direct search

You can look for companies or individuals who donate equipment via the internet, social media, or by checking with your network of contacts and close circles.

💬 For option 1, make a list of companies and the ways you can contact them—it could be through the people who handle the organization’s finances or those who manage their computer equipment.
The key is to get a direct contact at the donor company with whom you can speak in person, send an email, make a call, or send a letter. If you send a letter or email, make sure it will be read, and if the person isn’t the one making the decision, ensure they will redirect it to the right person.


Option 2: Outreach

You can write a post or announcement on social media making it clear that: 1. you need donated equipment in good condition; 2. you have a community project that will benefit many people; 3. include a number where they can reach you; 4. be clear about who you are and try to make the message evoke empathy and trust. An example message could be:


“Hi everyone! My name is Amaranta and I’m part of the XYZ FOUNDATION. Does anyone know of organizations that are donating computer equipment in good condition? We are looking for support to implement a project with seniors in rural areas of Colombia. Any information or contact would be a huge help. Thanks!
My contact number is 123456789
We suggest doing both options at the same time; this will broaden your chances of finding a donor company.



💪🏽 Keep it up! At this point, it’s key to be persistent. There’s no magic formula; it’s a matter of knocking on doors and paving the way. In any case, if you’ve read this far, it’s because you have the drive to do it, and that is something to admire.



Step 2 → Wait for a response and don’t let the contact “go cold.”


Photo by Fauxels: Pexels
Once you’ve sent your requests, all that’s left is to wait and follow up continuously to get a response. Don’t let the contact go cold; if more than a week passes without a reply, write again or go in person if possible. When you get an affirmative response, be clear about the model under which you will receive the equipment: not all companies donate their equipment; some decide to give it away as a gift. There are two types of models:


Option 1: Gifting equipment

You might find a company or person who is simply giving their equipment away. Family members might give away equipment. When you contact them, make sure you understand the terms under which you will receive the equipment in this scenario.


Option 2: Donating equipment

Now, for companies that donate, it’s a different model where a second chance is given to equipment that is in good condition and can be used by people and communities who need it.
How does it work? Many companies have to perform upgrades that require changing their equipment or they need new technology to carry out their work, so they decide to donate and can receive a tax deduction.

⚠️ Keep in mind that for this to be possible, donor companies need to receive a donation certificate. If you aren’t part of a foundation, you must find an ally who can issue this certificate for you.

Who issues this certificate and how for companies that want to donate? To find an ally, think of a non-profit entity that has an active legal status and can issue these certificates for the companies donating the equipment. For example, foundations, cooperatives, or similar entities in your region. Talk to them and tell them about your purpose. If they decide to support you, ask them for guidance in this process.
We invite you to look up the story of Alex Cortés, an engineer who founded Fundación Click → with the goal of giving a second life to computers that many people, organizations, or companies no longer need; he decides to repair them, perform maintenance, and give them away or donate them to those who need them most. If you want to know more about his story, we invite you to look him up, along with his foundation and his journey.

⚠️⚠️ Important: You must be clear about how the equipment will be used, as legally the equipment will belong to the ally you found. Don’t forget to check that the equipment they give you is functional. We don’t want you to end up storing electronic waste that you’ll have to repair.



Step 3 → Receiving the equipment and building the relationship


Photo: Ketut Subiyanto - Pexels

Photo: Cytonn photography - Pexels
For the receipt of the equipment, in either of the two models, keep in mind that every company or person has their own procedure.
The delivery of the equipment might be a shipment, or you might have to pick it up or reach an agreement on the delivery location with the company or person making the donation. After delivery, it’s important to know what kind of relationship you want and can build with them:


Option 1: Gifting equipment

In this model, paperwork is usually not required to formalize the delivery. However, it is likely that the donors will want to establish a short- or medium-term relationship to know the destination and use of the equipment. If this is your case, we suggest making it explicit and maintaining cordial communication with them.

For example, although it is not mandatory, at Fundación SOLE Colombia, we usually formalize the process through a thank-you letter signed by both parties, where the delivery, the condition of the equipment, and our commitment to put it to good use are corroborated.



Option 2: Donating equipment

For the delivery, make a donation request explaining your interests, conditions, and the cooperation you will build.
How many computers do you need? What condition is the equipment you are going to receive in? What does the donor company need from you? What will you use the equipment for? Who will be the people and communities benefiting? For this option, we suggest that, just like in option 1, you consider the possibility of building a bond with the donor company.

At SOLE Colombia, we usually send the donor companies photographs that thank them and show the community use of the equipment, with which we try to open the door to future donations.


What does community use of equipment imply?
Do you remember what we mentioned at the beginning of this solution about the chances you have of receiving a donation if you demonstrate that the use of the equipment will be communal? Now we invite you to reflect on the importance that collective use of equipment can have in a community. It’s not just about receiving them, but about reaching agreements on who will manage them, how they will be used, and how often; this will involve fostering dialogue and teamwork. It’s not about having a lot of equipment, but about knowing how to use it as a community.

See you soon! We invite you to research other solutions and keep tinkering.


How to know if this solution works?
When you receive equipment that others aren’t using, you’ve proven that this solution works. You will also have created a relationship with someone; that is beautiful and powerful. Someone who has tuned into your purpose and wants to lend you a hand.
As you build new relationships, you will feel more and more confident in finding potential donors. Now that you have equipment, would you be up for trying another solution? Browse more Voltaje solutions →

Other possible Internets
When you cultivate the relationship with your donors, it’s possible they might make donations more than once. Can you imagine if they donated a few computers to you every year? What would you do then with all that equipment?

If you want to know what we do at SOLE Colombia with the computers donated to us, take a look at www.solecolombia.org

Thinking about how you can extend this benefit to others is a way of making this world a fairer place. Would you like to try it in your community? Was this solution useful to you? We hope so! And if it was, share it with other people who you know could use it.
See you soon! 👋🏽
